كَلَامٌ مُرْقِصٌ (tropical:) Speech, or language, that makes one to be affected with a lively emotion of joy, or of grief. (TA.) You say also, هٰذِهِ مُرْقِصَةُ الصُّوفِيَّةِ [app. meaning, (assumed tropical:) This is that poem, or ode, which makes the mystics to dance; or to be affected with a lively emotion of joy: for darweeshes are often seen to be excited to frantic ecstasy, or ecstatic catalepsy, by certain love-songs designed to have a mystic religious sense]. (TA.) ―
-b2- فَلَاةٌ مُرْقِصَةٌ (tropical:) A desert that makes the traverser thereof to hasten, or go quickly. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
